changelog:
v2.0.0 - Major Update

• Aurora Cinema design with gold focus effects
• Movie & Series detail pages with artwork, ratings, and plot info
• Binge Watch with auto next-episode for series
• Quality badges on all movies (4K/FHD/HD/CAM/SD)
• New Releases virtual category
• Quick-Access Sidebar (DPAD Left)
• For You personalized recommendations
• FTS4 full-text search with autocomplete
• Picture-in-Picture mode
• Audio-Only mode for music/radio
• Live channel preview on focus
• Adaptive buffer control (3 network tiers)
• Smart category ordering based on watch habits
• Audio feedback for D-pad navigation
• Subscription status dashboard
• Deep link support (ooustream:// scheme)
• Onboarding tutorial for new users
